doc: Character creation — machine-readable mirror of world/creation-ui.md (canonical for behavior + copy). 'Joining the cast' per design §6: creating/hiring a character costs credits AND requires renting in-game housing in game dollars. New characters are not exempt from the sim. Prices adopt rw-monetization-plan-2026-09-22 §2.4–2.5 (PROPOSAL — never contradict in player-facing copy).

price.billing: flat, one-time, charged upfront after screening passes
price.refund_rule: denied applications never bill; a post-review denial auto-refunds in full

record_schema.id: h## — hired-character ids, disjoint from C1–C8 mains and A01–A20 ambients
record_schema.owner: player handle — the only account that may ever possess this character
record_schema.name: screened string; never a cast/ambient name, never a real person, never slurs
record_schema.age: integer >= 18 — player-possessable characters are adults, always
record_schema.bio: public profile text — screened; this IS the briefing-safe surface
record_schema.look: structured pickers (build/palette/style) — rendering data, not text
record_schema.arrival: one-line 'first day on the block' context — screened text
record_schema.unit_id: housing.json listings_live unit, or a room tier
record_schema.bank_game_dollars: starting balance — rent comes out of this, not credits
record_schema.brain: full LLM when possessed or ambient-active; thin AI when owner offline

screening.rules: world/moderation-notes.md §3 verbatim — naming strings always get a human review pass (§4)
screening.note: Screening covers what the player WROTE. Once created, the character's emergent behavior is inviolable — no moderation, ever.

what_the_player_authors: initial conditions only: identity surface, look, job application, lease
the character's inner life, secrets, and decisions emerge — players never write scripts, triggers, or loyalties
a hired character may decline a nudge like any main; possession is session-scoped
sim_obligations: pays rent monthly in game dollars — arrears and eviction apply like anyone else
works their job; thin-AI auto-shifts pay baseline wages
possession during a shift earns the same wage + small session bonus (never pay-to-earn-better)
offline owner → character drops to thin AI (cheap), wakes to full brain on return

feed_events.request: hire — '<name>' joined the cast (attributed, status resolved)
feed_events.cast: a new face on the block — <name>, <public bio one-liner> (bio text only post-screen)

progression_hooks: tenant → owner: purchase listings use the same 9xxx addresses; deed fee in credits after the earned game-dollar grind
owner → landlord: landlord license gates on earned in-world standing
